name: Landmarks (Barrelman)
description: Low-poly 3D landmark models from the Barrelman Landmarks collection, drawn in the 3D view in place of the buildings they represent.

barrelman-landmarks.purpose: Show 3D models of landmarks in the 3D view.
barrelman-landmarks.dataSent: Nothing about you. The OpenMapX server requests public catalogue and model files.
barrelman-landmarks.dataReceived: Landmark positions, metadata and 3D model files.

openstreetmap.purpose: Place each landmark model on the map and identify the buildings it replaces.
openstreetmap.dataSent: Nothing about you. The placements come with the landmark catalogue.
openstreetmap.dataReceived: Positions and OpenStreetMap identifiers of the buildings each model replaces.
